title: Avoid writing a disposable CI restore graph
goal: Suppress the on-disk NuGet dependency graph for a clean disposable build while retaining resolved assets, locked dependencies and a working application.

selectionNotes: Both actual SDK10.0.402/NuGet7.9 and SDK11 RC2/NuGet8 honour this switch. Do not infer newer-only availability from release notes.
Scope is disposable clean builds; normal incremental development keeps the default. No cache/no-op equivalence or speed saving is claimed.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Declared net11.0 application and SDK-host runtime. Exact RC2 artifacts are evidence, not GA qualification.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Documented feature family and current route; actual SDK10 servicing overlap is recorded separately, not a general down-level route.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Language setting of the compiled companion application; the MSBuild configuration itself is language-neutral.

packageAssets: Original local Beacon.Rates/1.0.0 package, net10.0 or net11.0 asset matched to the comparison. No independently distributed NuGet/MSBuild package substitutes the complete SDK.
platforms: Windows x64 is the executed platform; other platforms require separate qualification.
prerequisites: Complete SDK/runtime/ref installations. Tested SDK10.0.402, runtime/ref10.0.13, C#14; SDK11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105, runtime/ref11RC2, C#15.
PowerShell7 for the reproducible checks. Original local package setup uses no remote source; installed guidance is embedded offline.
constraints: Both actual SDK10.0.402/NuGet7.9 and SDK11 RC2/NuGet8 honour this switch. Do not infer newer-only availability from release notes.
Scope is disposable clean builds; normal incremental development keeps the default. No cache/no-op equivalence or speed saving is claimed.
Only target11 is advertised. The real .NET10 comparison adds no ninth foundation or general SDK11-on-net10 route.
No optional workload, provider, native compiler, rendering mode, production resource or public publication is required.
optIns: RestoreDoNotWriteDependencyGraphSpec=true only for the chosen disposable restore.
stabilityLimitations: These controls are not designated experimental in the cited documentation. Actual verification uses RC2; PIN-959/PIN-963 and existing Human gates remain open.
